findings.title: External value transfer precedes balance reduction
findings.severityRationale: A recipient contract can repeat withdrawals before the original balance reduction executes.
preconditions: the withdrawing recipient is a contract that reenters before its balance is reduced
the vault holds enough native currency for the repeated withdrawal
findings.potentialConsequence: The recipient can withdraw more native currency than its recorded balance.
findings.mitigation: Reduce the balance before the external call and enforce a reentrancy guard.
findings.validationMethod: Manual control-flow review of the frozen source confirmed the Slither signal.

limitations: This is a team-owned offline Solidity fixture, not a deployed-contract audit.
Only Slither signals mapped to the frozen Shield rules were eligible for promotion.

findings.title: Low-level payout result is ignored
findings.severityRationale: A failed target call does not prevent the contract from advancing its payment-attempt accounting.
preconditions: the owner invokes a target whose low-level call returns false
downstream accounting treats attemptedPayments as successful execution
findings.potentialConsequence: Off-chain or downstream logic can mistake a failed external call for a completed payment attempt.
findings.mitigation: Require the low-level call to succeed before updating accounting.
findings.validationMethod: Manual control-flow review of the frozen source confirmed the Slither signal.
